7200018.sum: Learn to defend a city's networks one breach at a time. Trace intruders, patch failing systems and keep the lights on in a near-future campus sim.

7200017.sum: A squad shooter about holding a server farm against waves of rogue drones. Persist is a tight, fast four-player co-op campaign.
7200017.story: When the Meridian data vault locks itself down, a contract crew is sent in to bring it back online. Inside, the vault's own defences have learned to fight back, and something in the core does not want to be restarted.

7200016.sum: Street racing across a sun-baked Los Angeles. Tune your car, take on rival crews and win the city one district at a time.

7200015.sum: An open-world role-playing game set in a kingdom where the crown has burned. Gather allies, pick a side in a war of succession and decide who wears what is left of it.
7200015.story: The Ashen Crown was forged to bind seven houses to one throne. When the king dies in a fire that no one survives to explain, the crown is found intact in the ashes, and every house claims it was meant for them.

7200014.sum: A chase through a haunted manor and the grounds around it, built for motion controls. Play alone or with a friend on the same couch.

7200013.sum: A cheerful platformer across flooded lowlands. Hop between rooftops, ride the tide and rescue villagers before the dikes give way.

7200012.sum: A party singing game with forty songs and a microphone duel mode for up to four players.

7200003.sum: A rhythm game built around flamenco and jazz guitar. Play along with a real guitar or the controller and work up to a three-guitar stage show.

7200008.sum: A hack-and-slash role-playing game of duels, curses and borrowed blades. Every weapon you take from a fallen enemy remembers how it was used.
7200008.story: The swordsmiths of Varn sealed their best work into the blades themselves. Three centuries later the forges are cold, the blades are scattered, and the last smith's apprentice sets out to bring them home before the men who stole them learn what they can do.

7200011.sum: A one-on-one fighting game with twelve martial artists, each fighting in the style of a mythical bird.
